content:
{
  "root_cause": "The drawer does not move focus when opened because the native showModal() call does not transfer focus; focus remains on the trigger button, preventing keyboard users from interacting with the dialog.",
  "repair_strategy": "Add focus management to dialog-base.ts: after showing the dialog, move focus to the first focusable element inside it. Implement a private helper method that queries for focusable candidates, skips hidden or disabled elements, and focuses the first match, falling back to the dialog itself.",
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Opening the drawer will shift focus into it, allowing users to press Tab to reach the first filter checkbox and operate the dialog entirely with the keyboard.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "May override an explicit autofocus attribute if present.",
    "If the dialog contains no focusable elements, focus will fall back to the dialog container, which may not be ideal.",
    "Incorrectly focusing hidden elements could confuse users; mitigated by checking offset dimensions."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "After activating the Filters button with Enter, focus must be on the close button (#filters-close).",
    "Pressing Tab moves focus to the In stock checkbox.",
    "Checking the In stock checkbox and pressing Enter on Show results updates the applied output to 'in'.",
    "Escape key closes the drawer and returns focus to the Filters button."
  ]
}
